core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness, no onward chain
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Freehold mid-terrace house in Sheerness with two bedrooms, one reception room and rear yard. Requires modernisation. No onward chain. Guide Price £150,000.
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation and offers a rear yard.

The ground floor provides one reception room. The first floor has two bedrooms and one bathroom.

Outside, there is a rear yard. Parking is available on-street and no permit is required.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness ME12.

Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Modern Method of Auction: the buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. No onward chain.
